messages:
maria: Heads up — sample-app onboarding failing in JSON mode + fncall. Looks like helper `parsePad` is leaving trailing NULs and a stray newline so our schema validator chokes. Error: "Unexpected token \u0000 in JSON at position 512"

jon: Which SDK/lang and sample? can you paste the payload that fails?

maria: Node starter-kit, @redwood/sdk v0.18.3. Repro: `npm run sample:local` -> call /generate -> crash. Minimal failing payload: ```json
{"tool_call": {"name":"upsert_user","args":"{\"id\":\"u123\"}\u0000\n"}}```

alex: This rings a bell — we added parsePad to handle streaming partial frames but didn't trim pad chars for non-streaming responses. Node helper strips differently than python. @jon any parity gap?

jon: Confirmed. Node has `stripPad()` in runtime path; python only rstrips in streaming handler. Also saw auth/retry weirdness: token refresh mid-request can trigger a retry that double-encodes the body which then gets parse-padded.

maria: Ugh, that explains the double-escaped JSON in tool args we saw in support tickets.

sam: Support has 3 tickets this week for "malformed tool args" during onboarding. Affected customers are on SSO + short-lived tokens. We need a hotfix.

ci-bot: Build #5421 failed: tests/sdk-jsonmode-toolcall -> parsing.test.ts:45

jon: Plan: 1) make `parsePad` a no-op unless stream flag true; 2) normalize token-refresh retry to preserve raw request body; 3) add unit tests for trailing NULs + double-encode. PR in ~1h.

maria: Can you add a short migration note for the sample-app quickstart? New users hit this before upgrading.

jon: Will do. Also adding a `compact_json` option to sample-app so dev envs avoid the helper.

alex: For Dedicated/Private deployments we should gate behavior via env var `REDWOOD_PARSE_PAD=off` so customers pinned to older runtimes don't break.

sam: I'll draft a support KB and a template reply: recommend `export REDWOOD_PARSE_PAD=off` or pin to `@redwood/sdk@0.18.2` as workaround.

maria: :thumbsup: marking as blocker for next patch release.

ci-bot: PR #1147 created by jon: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/1147 (tests failing currently)

jon: Tests updated for node + py parity, pushing fix for the retry double-encode now. pinging @alex for quick review.

alex: Reviewing, small nits. Tests look solid. merge after CI green.

ci-bot: Build #5424 green. Merge pipeline passed.

maria: Verified sample-app onboarding locally with the patch — JSON mode + fncall now parses and schema validation passes. Thanks y'all.

sam: KB updated and ticket templates sent.

ci-bot: PR #1147 merged by jon at 2654321037
